title: Constructing Two Increasing Arrays
summary: Replace each 0 with a positive even integer and each 1 with a positive odd integer. Each resulting array must be strictly increasing. Every assigned integer must be distinct across BOTH arrays. Return the smallest achievable maximum assigned integer, not the arrays.
